channel.description: Latest articles from Ocean News & Technology Magazine (oceannews.com)

item.title: DNV Launches Industrial Services to Support Rapidly Expanding Energy and Infrastructure Markets
item.description: DNV has launched Industrial Services, evolving its inspection business into a dedicated global provider of quality assurance and inspection services for energy, infrastructure and complex industrial supply chains.

item.title: Lloyd’s Register Verifies GT Wings’ Performance Assessment Methodology for AirWing Jet Sail
item.description: GT Wings, provider of unique wind propulsion systems to the commercial shipping industry, has secured Lloyd's Register verification of sea trials performance assessment methodology for its AirWing™ Jet Sail technology.

item.title: L3Harris Secures Full-Rate Production Contract for US Navy Submarine Communication Systems
item.description: L3Harris Technologies has received its largest full-rate production contract for communications systems from General Dynamics Electric Boat to deliver 26 shipsets for Virginia- and Columbia-class submarines. By utilizing state-of-the-art technology, these systems will enhance situational awareness and communication across submarine crews.

item.title: Naval Group and Thales Join Forces for a Sovereign AI in France
item.description: Naval Group has invested in the capital of cortAIx France, joining Thales to address major challenges related to integrating AI into critical defense systems. This unprecedented alliance will accelerate the deployment of AI technologies and their adoption by the armed forces, while upholding algorithm sovereignty and safeguarding sensitive data. item.title: First foundations for Ørsted’s Hornsea 3 Offshore Wind Farm Arrive in the UK
item.description: Ørsted has taken delivery of the first sets of monopiles for its Hornsea 3 Offshore Wind Farm. In total, six of the massive structures have now arrived at Teesside in the UK from manufacturer Haizea after travelling 960 nautical miles in two batches from Bilbao in Spain.

item.title: Mammoet Delivers Record UAE Loadout for Major Gas Development
item.description: Mammoet has safely completed the weighing, transport, and loadout of 24 PAU and PAR modules for a major gas development project.

item.title: Eco Wave Power Completes Feasibility Study for Wave Energy Project at Port of Ngqura
item.description: Eco Wave Power Global AB (Eco Wave Power) a leading onshore wave energy technology company, announced the successful completion of a feasibility study for a potential wave energy power station at the Port of Ngqura, South Africa.

item.title: Nauticus Robotics, Inc. Announces Major Leadership Enhancements, Aquanaut Manufacturing Expansion, and Accelerated Growth Strategy
item.description: Nauticus Robotics, Inc. (Nauticus), a pioneer in autonomous subsea robotics and AI-driven offshore solutions, announced a series of strategic leadership appointments and commercialization initiatives designed to accelerate product growth, expand manufacturing capacity, and position the Company for its next phase of scale.

item.title: DOF Group Announces Offshore Operations Contract Award in Argentina
item.description: DOF Group ASA (DOF) has announced the award of a Substantial contract for a project in Argentina. The project is scheduled for offshore operations across two campaigns in Q2 and Q3-Q4 of 2026 and will encompass mooring pre-lay, pipeline end manifold installation/construction management, tie-in spools installation, hook-up and pre-commissioning of two CALM buoys, and diving services. item.title: BOEM Proposes Third Gulf of America Lease Sale
item.description: The Bureau of Ocean Energy Management announced a Proposed Notice of Sale for the third offshore oil and gas lease sale under the One Big Beautiful Bill Act. The proposed lease sale, known as Lease Sale Big Beautiful Gulf 3, or BBG3, is scheduled to take place on Aug. 12, 2026.
